roots.name: Iut.Corollary22Inputs.c2
roots.elaboratedType:
∀ {T : Genl.HeightTheory} {AG : Iut.AnabelianGeometry} {TG : Iut.TemperedGeometry AG} {K : T.CBS} {d : ℕ}
  (I : Iut.Corollary22Inputs T K d) {P : Iut.Corollary312VariantData AG TG → Prop},
  1 ≤ d →
    Iut.ThetaDataExistence P I →
      ∀ (cheb : Iut.ChebyshevBound) (pnt : Iut.PrimeCountingBound),
        (∀ (X : Iut.Corollary312VariantData AG TG), P X → Iut.Corollary312Variant X) →
          ∀ x ∈ T.cbsSet K ∩ T.ptLE T.tripod d,
            x ∉ I.excCore →
              I.threshold cheb ≤ I.h x →
                1 / 6 * I.h x ≤
                    (1 + Iut.epsilonE (Iut.deltaBound d) (I.h x)) * (T.logDiff T.tripod x + T.logCond T.tripod x) +
                      (40 * pnt.η + I.B / 3) ∧
                  Iut.epsilonE (Iut.deltaBound d) (I.h x) ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ T.logDiff T.tripod x + T.logCond T.tripod x

roots.name: Iut.Theorem110Invariants.theorem110
roots.elaboratedType:
∀ {AG : Iut.AnabelianGeometry} {TG : Iut.TemperedGeometry AG} {X : Iut.Corollary312VariantData AG TG}
  (inv : Iut.Theorem110Invariants X),
  Iut.Theorem110Certificate inv →
    ∀ (est : inv.LocalEstimate) (pnt : Iut.PrimeCountingBound),
      Iut.Corollary312Variant X →
        1 / 6 * X.qPilot.logQ ≤
          (1 + 20 * ↑X.dmod / ↑X.ℓ) * (inv.logDtpd + inv.logFtpd) + 20 * (↑inv.eStar * ↑X.ℓ + pnt.η)
